The Art Gallery:
Open for Season April 7, 2018 – Open Saturdays 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. and Sundays, Noon to 4:00 p.m.

Meet the Artist, Larry Folding –Special for ArtWeek, our Meet the Artist series kicks off the 2018 season at The Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists. Larry Folding will demonstrate a Cape Cod painting in watercolor on April 28 from 2:00 to 4:00 p.m.
Bank Shows:
During the month of April, Guild members will be exhibiting their art at local banks:
Chris Banks, at the Cooperative Bank of Cape Cod, East Harwich
Elaine Felos Ostrander, at Cape Cod Five Cents, Harwich Port
Kathleen Magnusson at Cape Cod Five Cents, East Harwich
Member News:

Congratulations to Larry Folding who had a painting accepted in the upcoming National Watercolor Society (NWS) 2018 Annual Members Exhibition held at the NWS Gallery in San Pedro California. Exhibit dates are May 3 through June 30, 2018.

Lydia Bell was awarded First in Watercolor at the Chatham Creative Arts Center Member Show, on exhibit through April 2. Kathleen Magnusson won an Honorable Mention Award in the show as well. Guild members exhibiting in the show included Elaine Ostrander and Yvette Stenzel.
The juried “CAPE COD EXHIBIT” at the Cultural Center of Cape Cod in Yarmouth was on exhibit through April 1. Art from Guild members Elaine Felos Ostrander and Kathleen Magnusson were accepted.
The annual “Toast of Harwich” will be held on April 27 at the Wequassett Inn. Members Elaine Felos Ostrander and Martha Little Fuentes will be “live painting” at the event.

pwsbuilder April 3, 2018

April Meetings:
Executive Board Meeting:  Monday, April 9, 2018, 9:30a.m. at Harwich Chamber of Commerce Board Room, 1 Schoolhouse Road, Harwich Port
Gallery Meeting:  Saturday, April 21, 2018, 12:30 p.m
Guild Meeting:  Saturday, April 21, 2018, 2:00 p.m.  Presentation by Andrew Kusmin, Watercolor Artist

Painting Workshops:
Open Painting Thursdays from 1:00 to 4:00 p.m. at the Harwich Community Center, 100 Oak Street, Harwich

The Art Gallery:
Open for Season April 7, 2018 – Open Saturdays 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. and Sundays, Noon to 4:00 p.m.
Meet the Artist, Larry Folding –Special for ArtWeek, our Meet the Artist series kicks off  the 2018 season at The Art Gallery of the Guild of Harwich Artists. Larry Folding will demonstrate a Cape Cod painting in watercolor on April 28 from 2:00 to 4:00 p.m.

Bank Shows: 
During the month of April, Guild members will be exhibiting their art at local banks:
Chris Banks, at the Cooperative Bank of Cape Cod, East Harwich
Elaine Felos Ostrander, at Cape Cod Five Cents, Harwich Port
Kathleen Magnusson at Cape Cod Five Cents, East Harwich

Member News:
Congratulations to Larry Folding who had a painting accepted in the upcoming National Watercolor Society (NWS) 2018 Annual Members Exhibition held at the NWS Gallery in San Pedro California. Exhibit dates are May 3 through June 30, 2018.

Lydia Bell was awarded First in Watercolor at the Chatham Creative Arts Center Member Show, on exhibit through April 2.  Kathleen Magnusson won an Honorable Mention Award in the show as well. Guild members exhibiting in the show included Elaine Ostrander and Yvette Stenzel.

The juried “CAPE COD EXHIBIT” at the Cultural Center of Cape Cod in Yarmouth was on exhibit through April 1. Art from Guild members Elaine Felos Ostrander and Kathleen Magnusson were accepted.

The annual “Toast of Harwich” will be held on April 27 at the Wequassett Inn. Members Elaine Felos Ostrander and Martha Little Fuentes will be “live painting” at the event.
